description.p: A simple viewer for 3D models, point clouds, splats and CAD files: open a file, look at it, turn it. Meshes, scans and CAD drawings are read by the same libraries as F3D. On a stereo display the model is drawn as two pictures, one for each eye; how far apart they are is the depth the person set for the desktop.
